title: Regular tasks
lead: Short tasks for a category. Candidates answer each once. An answer narrows the profile uncertainty on the task topics, and only you see the answer itself, without name or contacts.
needCompany: Tasks are published by a company: fill in its profile first.

active.title: No active tasks
active.text: Publish a task for a specialization and grade: candidates will pick it from the catalog.

review.title: Everything is graded
review.text: Answers to open tasks that await your grading will show up here.

withdrawn.title: No withdrawn tasks
withdrawn.text: A withdrawn task leaves the catalog. Its answers and grades stay in the profiles.

drawerLead: A task can be edited until someone answers it.

fields.gradeHint: The grade sets the difficulty: a correct answer to a senior task weighs more.

kindHint.reference: The system checks a string or number answer. The candidate does not see the verdict.
kindHint.open: A script or a solution: you grade the answer on a 0 to 3 rubric.

withdraw.title: Withdraw the task from the catalog?
withdraw.text: Candidates will no longer be able to take it. Answers and grades stay in the profiles. The task cannot be restored.

answers.emptyText: Candidates of the specialization will see the task in the catalog and answer once.

grade.label: Rubric grade
grade.confirmText: A grade is given once and cannot be changed. It narrows the candidate's profile uncertainty on the task topics.

rubric.3: Correct and good: optimal, edge cases covered
